faq.q: Are you an authorized Sub-Zero servicer?
faq.a: No. We are an independent repair company, not affiliated with or authorized by Sub-Zero, and we repair Sub-Zero appliances with OEM parts.

faq.q: Do you repair Sub-Zero wine storage units?
faq.a: Yes, along with built-in and integrated Sub-Zero refrigerators.

faq.q: How long does a Sub-Zero repair take?
faq.a: Most take one to three hours; sealed-system work can need a second visit.
